The camera is positioned at a high angle, looking down on the city from a static viewpoint. The Chicago River flows diagonally from the bottom right to the upper left, occupying the middle ground and dividing the frame. Several bridges cross the river; the closest one spans the middle ground from the bottom left to the center-right, while others are positioned further back in the background. The left side of the frame, from the foreground to the middle ground, is dominated by a massive traffic jam and dense crowds of people along the riverbank and sidewalks, with a tall building occupying the immediate foreground on the far left. In the middle ground, a white police car and several military trucks are positioned on the central bridge. On the right side of the frame, a building under construction is visible in the middle ground, and a white boat is docked along the river's edge, while the background is filled with numerous skyscrapers.
